panels.visual: The harbour town of Nafplio in the 1830s with a fortress above, flags, the new Greek capital looking busy
panels.caption: Nafplio was the first capital of modern Greece after independence.

panels.visual: Ioannis Kapodistrias (dignified man in a dark coat, white hair) walking up the street to church with guards behind
panels.caption: Its first head of state was Ioannis Kapodistrias.

panels.visual: The church of Saint Spyridon in Nafplio on a dawn street, a quiet moment before danger, two shadows lurking at the corner
panels.caption: On 9 October 1831 he was attacked outside the church of Saint Spyridon by two men from a rival family.

panels.visual: A small bullet hole in the church wall behind a pane of glass, a hand pointing at it, Glauka perched beside it
panels.caption: A bullet hole is still in the wall, behind glass, for nearly two hundred years.
